verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe fine-grained reactivity where only dependent code reruns, components run once, and a `<div>` is a real div with bare-metal DOM access. Together with community reports of fine-grained reactive updates via dom-expressions and top benchmark performance, this clearly points to direct DOM updates without a virtual-DOM diffing step. missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement that Solid has no virtual DOM, and documentation of the compiler/JSX transform optimizations (only implied by the `jsx: preserve` config and the dom-expressions mention).
